items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Was that in the A network studio that we recorded in? with Mark Warner?

ctx.x: studios, you see, in the network studio -- even if it wasn't on a show. That was some achievement of some sort. You may not have realized it or thought about it at the time; maybe it wasn't -- but did you -- do you recall that this was something new for a black musician to record in a major studio?
Well, what do you mean, in a major studio? Was that in the A network studio that we recorded in? with Mark Warner? It wasn't for radio.
No, this was just purely for records.
